subject: Recovered proof QA: source preserved, identity failed; one controlled repair preparing
body:
QA update from the active root operator: the correct proof is recovered: 69 frames, 768 x 432, 24 fps, 2.875 seconds, with source offset 0 throughout. Preserved-region error is 2.124/255, essentially the compression baseline of 2.125. Audio is 48 kHz stereo AAC, starts at 0, correlation 0.999047 and lag 0; there is 5 ms of AAC padding.

Identity failed: 96.4% of editable core pixels are near black and the actor face is absent. The failed proof is unaccepted; the original source remains unchanged.

Root is preparing ONE controlled repair: separate broader full-face GENERATION conditioning from the tight FINAL protected composite. The final mask remains unchanged so the original tattoos, grill and jewelry are restored. Same media, models, seed 42 and 6 steps; no repair run yet, no new uploads or batches. No new approval is needed for this preparation.

The resolved durable-host Nova Dot send also failed with the known internal path error. This linked mailbox update is posted only; direct delivery, reading or wakeup remains unconfirmed.

source.description: Root reports actual recovered-file metrics, quantitative preservation/audio checks, confirmed failed identity pixels and controlled repair preparation. File writer did not independently decode or inspect the media.
